summative_rubric.title: Measure Maven — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: Used during and after Lesson 5 to score against all 4 expectations.

rows.expectation_text: choose and use non-standard units appropriately to measure lengths, and describe the inverse relationship between the size of a unit and the number of units needed

levels.descriptor: Uses cubes for everything. Cannot articulate inverse.
Independently picks the right unit and articulates inverse relationship.
Predicts count from unit choice, demonstrates inverse with multiple units.

rows.expectation_text: explain the relationship between centimetres and metres as units of length, and use benchmarks for these units to estimate lengths

levels.descriptor: Independently uses cm/m + benchmarks for estimation.
Estimates within 10% accuracy and converts mixed mm/cm/m.

rows.expectation_text: measure and draw lengths in centimetres and metres, using a measuring tool, and recognize the impact of starting at points other than zero

levels.descriptor: Independently starts at zero and draws lengths accurately.
Recognizes and corrects zero-errors in others' work.

rows.expectation_text: use units of time, including seconds, minutes, hours, and non-standard units, to describe the duration of various events

levels.descriptor: Independently picks right unit and uses 60 rule.
Estimates duration accurately and reasons about magnitude.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Score during Lesson 5 capstone. Level 3 = grade-level.

summative_task_script.title: Measure Marathon Capstone — Summative Administration Guide
summative_task_script.purpose: Ties Lesson 5 capstone, the 4 stations, and the rubric together.
administration_steps: Before: photocopy templates, print rubric, ready Junior Measure Maven certificates.
Stations 1-4 (6 min each): UNIT, cm/m, RULER, TIME.
Station 1 UNIT: pick + measure 3 objects. Evidence E2.1.
Station 2 cm/m: estimate 4 lengths. Evidence E2.2.
Station 3 RULER: measure + draw. Evidence E2.3.
Station 4 TIME: pick units for 4 events. Evidence E2.4.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Use the Capstone Template as primary evidence. Level 3 = grade-level.
